integrity: Complete algebraic proofs for all characteristics; independent root-test enumeration is finite corroboration only; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to monic quadratics and nonconstant affine steps; count in odd characteristic at least five uses three explicit elliptic traces; higher-degree and longer progressions not addressed.
title: Exact four-term progressions of irreducible monic quadratics over all finite fields
